title: Officer points to his phone when giants come up
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Officer points to his phone when giants come up, about unspecified at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: But when you bring up giants, one of them literally went like this to me, pointed to his phone.

plain: Tim Alberino, who claims US troops captured a 12-foot giant in Afghanistan, told the podcast host Jesse Michels about talking with military officers. He says that when he raised the subject of giants, one of them said nothing and simply pointed at his phone. Alberino tells it as a sign the topic was too sensitive to discuss where it might be heard.
